text:
lina_support: FYI customer acme-mobile hitting intermittent 400s (dimension mismatch) + big p99 on /v1/embeddings. Ticket INC-4532, started after a recent SDK bump. Logs attached.

sarah_client: here's the minimal repro they sent from Node SDK 2.7.1 (started after upgrade):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
Response snippet they see:
```json
{"error":"dimension mismatch: expected 1024 got 512"}
```

mike_eng_ml: thanks — can you paste raw request headers/dump? curious if coalescing is grouping different variants.

sarah_client: they included dumps: header `x-client-sdk: node/2.7.1`, concurrency ~128 from a server pool, and their app occasionally calls `embed-small` and `embed-large` from same process.

eng-oncall-bot: alert: embeddings-prod-1 p99 spiked to 4.8s between 10:12-10:17 UTC, error_rate ~0.6% dimension-mismatch.

mike_eng_ml: quick hypothesis: dynamic coalescing is combining embed-small (512-dim) and embed-large (1024-dim) variants into a single batch on the forwarding/coalescer layer. The runtime assumes homogeneous batch vectors and fails when variants differ. That would also explain tail latency (retries/fallbacks + batch assembly delays).

devex_jordan: I reproduced locally with a small script by alternating model parameter at high qps — got the exact `dimension mismatch` errors. snippet attached: 
```python
import requests,threading
URL='https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings'
KEY='REDACTED'
def call(model):
  r=requests.post(URL, json={'model':model,'input':['hi']}, headers={'Authorization':f'Bearer {KEY}'})
  print(model,r.status_code,r.text)
for i in range(200):
  t=threading.Thread(target=call, args=('embed-small' if i%2 else 'embed-large',))
  t.start()
```

maria_infra: looking at the coalescer code — routing key currently omits model_variant/dim tag when routes are considered compatible. bug: if two variants share route capability we still coalesce them; need model_family+dim in coalescing key. I'll open a PR.

lina_support: customer asked for immediate mitigation — what can we tell them to do now?

mike_eng_ml: short-term guidance: pin to a single variant (set `model` param explicitly to same variant across calls) or reduce concurrency. We also have a temporary flag `x-rw-prefer-isolation: 1` that forces per-request isolation on canary — recommend using that until fix rolls out. Another option is to set `max_batch_size=1` in request-level config to avoid coalescing.

sarah_client: customer applied pin-to-variant workaround (all calls to `embed-large`) — errors stopped and tail latency normalized. They want ETA for root fix.

maria_infra: PR created to include variant/dim in coalescer key, plus unit tests. Plan: hotfix to canary tonight, full rollout tomorrow morning. Also adding a metric `batch_variant_mismatch_count` and an alert to catch regressions.

mike_eng_ml: followup: add a clearer rejection early in coalescer (409 conflict with message about mixed-variant batches) so client SDKs can retry without ambiguous 400s. I'll draft the change.

lina_support: updated ticket INC-4532 with workaround + ETA, emailing customer. cc @devex_jordan @maria_infra @mike_eng_ml :thumbsup: 

eng-oncall-bot: deploy scheduled: `coalescer-fix` -> canary at 23:00 UTC.

lina_support: closing note — customer confirmed they received the update and will wait on hotfix. will monitor canary metrics after deploy and update the ticket.
